name: Experimental Speaker
body:
Prerequisite(s) no levels of a class that grants the Words of Foundation class feature, ability to cast spells, Linguistics 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Select one class that grants you the ability to cast spells. You can now use your highest level spell slots from that class to speak a limited number of Words, treating your level in that class as your Speaker level. Learn the following Identifying Words: All, Ally, Enemy, and Self. In addition, learn one Word of Foundation that you meet the prerequisites for. The Word and Identifying Word must be prepared if you are a prepared spellcaster.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Each additional time you select this feat, learn an additional Word of Foundation that you meet the prerequisites for.

Speaker: A Pathfinder 1e class designed for use in the Lost Lands, © 2021, Michael Mars, Author Michael Mars Russell
